lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਜੋ ਜੀਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਰਤੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: too karataa sabh kichh jaanadaa jo jeeaa a(n)dar varatai ||
lines.translation: You, O Creator, know everything which occurs within our beings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਅਗਣਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਗਣਤੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: too karataa aap aganat hai sabh jag vich ganatai ||
lines.translation: You Yourself, O Creator, are incalculable, while the entire world is within the realm of calculation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਣਤੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh keetaa teraa varatadaa sabh teree banatai ||
lines.translation: Everything happens according to Your Will; You created all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਇਕੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਚਲਤੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: too ghat ghat ik varatadaa sach saahib chalatai ||
lines.translation: You are the One, pervading in each and every heart; O True Lord and Master, this is Your play.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨੋ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਪਰਤੈ ॥੨੪॥
lines.transliteration: satigur no mile s har mile naahee kisai paratai ||24||
lines.translation: One who meets the True Guru meets the Lord; no one can turn him away. ||24||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਕਰਿ ਰਖੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਈਐ ਚਿਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: ihu manooaa driR kar rakheeai guramukh laaeeai chit ||
lines.translation: Hold this mind steady and stable; become Gurmukh and focus your consciousness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ਬਹਦਿਆ ਉਠਦਿਆ ਨਿਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiu saas giraas visaareeai bahadiaa uthadiaa nit ||
lines.translation: How could you ever forget Him, with each breath and morsel of food, sitting down or standing up?

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਰਣ ਜੀਵਣ ਕੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਗਈ ਇਹੁ ਜੀਅੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਵਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: maran jeevan kee chi(n)taa gaee ihu jeeaRaa har prabh vas ||
lines.translation: My anxiety about birth and death has ended; this soul is under the control of the Lord God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਖੁ ਤੂ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਖਸਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jiu bhaavai tiu rakh too jan naanak naam bakhas ||1||
lines.translation: If it pleases You, then save servant Nanak, and bless him with Your Name. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਆਗੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਪੀਛੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh aha(n)kaaree mahal na jaanai khin aagai khin peechhai ||
lines.translation: The egotistical, self-willed manmukh does not know the Mansion of the Lord's Presence; one moment he is here, and the next moment he is there.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਬੁਲਾਈਐ ਮਹਲਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਸੀਝੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa bulaaeeai mahal na aavai kiu kar daragah seejhai ||
lines.translation: He is always invited, but he does not go to the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. How shall he be accepted in the Court of the Lord?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur kaa mahal viralaa jaanai sadaa rahai kar joR ||
lines.translation: How rare are those who know the Mansion of the True Guru; they stand with their palms pressed together.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਣੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਏ ਬਹੋੜਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: aapanee kripaa kare har meraa naanak lae bahoR ||2||
lines.translation: If my Lord grants His Grace, O Nanak, He restores them to Himself. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਸੇਵਾ ਕੀਤੀ ਸਫਲ ਹੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਮੰਨੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: saa sevaa keetee saphal hai jit satigur kaa man ma(n)ne ||
lines.translation: Fruitful and rewarding is that service, which is pleasing to the Guru's Mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਤਾ ਪਾਪ ਕਸੰਮਲ ਭੰਨੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa satigur kaa man ma(n)niaa taa paap kasa(n)mal bha(n)ne ||
lines.translation: When the Mind of the True Guru is pleased, then sins and misdeeds run away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਜਿ ਦਿਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸੋ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਸਿਖੀ ਕੰਨੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: upades j ditaa satiguroo so suniaa sikhee ka(n)ne ||
lines.translation: The Sikhs listen to the Teachings imparted by the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਚੜੀ ਚਵਗਣਿ ਵੰਨੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin satigur kaa bhaanaa ma(n)niaa tin chaRee chavagan va(n)ne ||
lines.translation: Those who surrender to the True Guru's Will are imbued with the four-fold Love of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਚਾਲ ਨਿਰਾਲੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖੀ ਗੁਰ ਦੀਖਿਆ ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨੁ ਭਿੰਨੇ ॥੨੫॥
lines.transliteration: ih chaal niraalee guramukhee gur deekhiaa sun man bhi(n)ne ||25||
lines.translation: This is the unique and distinct life-style of the Gurmukhs: listening to the Guru's Teachings, their minds blossom forth. ||25||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਪਿਆ ਆਪਣਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਠਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin gur gopiaa aapanaa tis thaur na thaau ||
lines.translation: Those who do not affirm their Guru shall have no home or place of rest.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਦੋਵੈ ਗਏ ਦਰਗਹ ਨਾਹੀ ਥਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: halat palat dovai gae daragah naahee thaau ||
lines.translation: They lose both this world and the next; they have no place in the Court of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਹ ਵੇਲਾ ਹਥਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਲਗਹਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: oh velaa hath na aavaee phir satigur lagahi paai ||
lines.translation: This opportunity to bow at the Feet of the True Guru shall never come again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਗਣਤੈ ਘੁਸੀਐ ਦੁਖੇ ਦੁਖਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur kee ganatai ghuseeai dukhe dukh vihaai ||
lines.translation: If they miss out on being counted by the True Guru, they shall pass their lives in pain and misery.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur purakh niravair hai aape lae jis laai ||
lines.translation: The True Guru, the Primal Being, has no hatred or vengeance; He unites with Himself those with whom He is pleased.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਜਿਨਾ ਵੇਖਾਲਿਓਨੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਦਰਗਹ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak darasan jinaa vekhaalion tinaa daragah lae chhadaai ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those who behold the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, are emancipated in the Court of the Lord. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh agiaan duramat aha(n)kaaree ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukh is ignorant, evil-minded and egotistical.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਜੂਐ ਮਤਿ ਹਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar krodh jooai mat haaree ||
lines.translation: He is filled with anger within, and he loses his mind in the gamble.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਕੁਸਤੁ ਓਹੁ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kooR kusat ohu paap kamaavai ||
lines.translation: He commits the sins of fraud and unrighteousness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਓਹੁ ਸੁਣੈ ਕਿਆ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiaa ohu sunai kiaa aakh sunaavai ||
lines.translation: What can he hear, and what can he tell others?

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਨਾ ਬੋਲਾ ਖੁਇ ਉਝੜਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)naa bolaa khui ujhaR paai ||
lines.translation: He is blind and deaf; he loses his way, and wanders lost in the wilderness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅੰਧਾ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh a(n)dhaa aavai jaai ||
lines.translation: The blind, self-willed manmukh comes and goes in reincarnation;

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin satigur bhete thaai na paai ||
lines.translation: without meeting the True Guru, he finds no place of rest.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak poorab likhiaa kamaai ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, he acts according to his pre-ordained destiny. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕੇ ਚਿਤ ਕਠੋਰ ਹਹਿ ਸੇ ਬਹਹਿ ਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin ke chit kathor hahi se bahahi na satigur paas ||
lines.translation: Those who have hearts as hard as stone, do not sit near the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਥੈ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਕੂੜਿਆਰਾ ਚਿਤ ਉਦਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: othai sach varatadaa kooRiaaraa chit udaas ||
lines.translation: Truth prevails there; the false ones do not attune their consciousness to it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਵਲੁ ਛਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਝਤਿ ਕਢਦੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਬਹਹਿ ਕੂੜਿਆਰਾ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: oi val chhal kar jhat kadhade phir jaai bahahi kooRiaaraa paas ||
lines.translation: By hook or by crook, they pass their time, and then they go back to sit with the false ones again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਚਿ ਸਚੇ ਕੂੜੁ ਨ ਗਡਈ ਮਨਿ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਕੋ ਨਿਰਜਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: vich sache kooR na gadaee man vekhahu ko nirajaas ||
lines.translation: Falsehood does not mix with the Truth; O people, check it out and see.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ਕੂੜਿਆਰੀ ਜਾਇ ਰਲੇ ਸਚਿਆਰ ਸਿਖ ਬੈਠੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੨੬॥
lines.transliteration: kooRiaar kooRiaaree jaai rale sachiaar sikh baithe satigur paas ||26||
lines.translation: The false go and mingle with the false, while the truthful Sikhs sit by the side of the True Guru. ||26||
